title: Intern, Corporate Governance (6 Months)
salary_raw:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a motivated intern to support the Executive Office and Corporate Governance Team at N26 for 6 months. The Executive Office plays a key role in coordinating cross-functional work between C-level executives, ensuring efficiency in strategic planning and execution. As an Intern, Corporate Governance Team, you will gain hands-on experience in administrative support, project coordination, stakeholder management, and executive operations, making this an excellent opportunity to develop critical business and organizational skills in a fast-paced environment.
 
In this role you will:

  • Administrative & Financial Support: Assist in processing expense reports, purchase orders, and managing incoming correspondence for the Executive Office.
  • Travel & Logistics Coordination: Support travel arrangements, including research and bookings for flights, hotels, and team activities.
  • Meeting & Event Preparation: Prepare meeting materials, presentations, and agendas for high-level executive sessions.
  • Project Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to track deadlines, follow up on deliverables, and support Executive Office initiatives.
  • Stakeholder & Guest Management: Act as a liaison between the Executive Office, internal teams, and external visitors to facilitate seamless communication and hospitality.
  • Ad-Hoc Support: Assist with special projects and additional tasks as required by the Executive Office team.


What You Need to Be Successful:

  • Recently completed a Degree or Masters in Business, Finance, Law, Economics, Management, Politics, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (and German beneficial).
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and adaptable to a dynamic work environment.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) is an advantage.
  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and discretion in handling sensitive information.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions and prototypes within the Celonis software to critical business problems. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in enterprise technology sales.

The Role:

As a Strategic Program Management Intern within the Max Success Team you will support the steering of programs that implement/execute strategic decisions from our executive management into practice. These programs span across multiple organizations, centered in Value Engineering, spanning to Product, Strategy & Ops, Ecosystem, Services, Business Apps and others. You will ensure a program’s success by building up the strategic decisions.

  • Enable and shape data driven decision making for our management and leverage Celonis AI capabilities.

  • Take ownership of specific streams, ensuring their success.

  • Ability to act autonomously in high ambiguity situations
  • Stakeholder management skills

  • Confidence to present to C-level executives and larger audiences
  • Experience in consulting and highly interested in data analytics
  • Passion for technology, data, OpenAI and LLMs and the impact it can have on the world
  • This internship can be done from our Madrid Office or Munich Office.
  • Full-time availability for at least five months starting from December/ January 26/27

We launched the Meritocracy Fellowship to recover that highest purpose: find exceptionally talented individuals, forge them intellectually, give them responsibility, and judge them by their achievements alone. Based purely on merit and academic excellence, graduating high school students will be invited to interview, and select applicants will receive a Meritocracy Fellowship. Those that excel will obtain offers to join Palantir full time.

Skip the debt. Get the real education. Earn the Palantir degree.
 
The Curriculum
 
For five weeks, Fellows grapple with the ideas that shape our civilization. What is the West? Is it worth defending? In what ways is America exceptional within this broader context? And what is Palantir's mission in that context?

Fellows read great works, visit institutions at the frontiers of knowledge and public life, and work alongside one another to build something real. This is the education that universities were designed to deliver: rigorous, Socratic, grounded in the texts and ideas that actually matter. Not a lecture hall. Not a curriculum designed by committee. A room full of people who are smarter than you, expecting you to hold your own.

This initial period lays the intellectual foundation before Fellows join forward-deployed engineering or internal software teams. Fellows spend substantial time building in the first five weeks and learn from Palantirians working across engineering, product, security, deployment, and operations.

Our most vital technologies cannot be created by those indifferent to their purpose. Today's challenges demand builders who are guided by conviction and a clear sense of mission.

The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities.
